title: Tandem's tubeless pump lets users cut the cord
hook: 你的腰間掛著胰島素幫浦，一條細管像尾巴一樣拖著你走。
bridge: 如果這款新幫浦賣得好，對整間公司就像打了一劑強心針。
p: Tandem Diabetes Care says the FDA has cleared a tubeless version of its Mobi insulin pump. Instead of a tube and infusion set, users wear a disposable kit on the body, so they can finally {0}. The new infusion set and cartridge are cleared for up to seven days of wear.

Tandem plans a limited release in 2027, with full availability in the first half of that year, sold through pharmacies. Analysts at Leerink Partners called it the company's single most important commercial growth driver. If the launch goes well, it could be a real {1} for Tandem as it competes with Insulet in tubeless pumps.

words.def: to stop depending on something that has been holding you back or tying you down
words.mn: 幫浦的細管像一條臍帶，把使用者綁在機器旁。Tandem 的新款讓人拿起剪刀，喀嚓剪斷管子。管子沒了，就是擺脫束縛。
words.ex: Millions of households have cut the cord and switched to streaming.
words.exZh: 數百萬家庭不再訂有線電視，改看串流。

words.zh: 強心針、提振士氣或業績
words.def: something that gives new energy, confidence or momentum
words.mn: Tandem 業績需要提神，新款無管幫浦就像護理師一針打進手臂。針一推，公司立刻精神大振。一針打進手臂，就是強心針。
words.ex: The new funding was a shot in the arm for the struggling startup.
words.exZh: 這筆新資金對苦撐的新創公司是一劑強心針。

quiz.q: After years of cable bills, she finally ___ and moved everything online.
quiz.why: cut the cord 是擺脫束縛、不再依賴。bite the bullet 是硬著頭皮面對，jump the gun 是操之過急。

quiz.q: The surprise order was a real ___ for the small factory.
quiz.why: a shot in the arm 是強心針、提振。pain in the neck 是麻煩的人事物，a long shot 是成功機率很低的嘗試。
